st.t: Photo Gallery of HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Vicharan, Amdavad Page-1, 29 September 2002
w: Swamishri arrived at the Civil Hospital in Amdavad at 10:45 am. For 1½ hr. Swamishri made personal rounds to the injured pilgrims, members of the State Reserve Police Force and National Security Guard (Black Cat Commandos). He personally enquired of each victim as to what and how they were injured. Then he blessed them with the divine touch of his hand, showered sacred rose petals and prayed to Harikrishna Maharaj for their recovery. Swamishri also encouraged them with words of faith and hope.
Swamishri arrived by plane from Kisumu at Entebbe Airport in Kampala at 11.00 am. In the evening a welcome assembly was held in the BAPS mandir compound.

Over 80 devotees participated in the grand procession through the streets of Jinja. Hundreds of local residents lined the route and also enjoyed the colourful spectacle. In the evening, the sadhus presented a superb kirtan aradhana, after which a 30-minute fireworks display was held.

Today after the afternoon meetings, Mahant Swami Maharaj went for darshan of Thakorji's thal, which was going on in the room right beside the meeting room. He sat right down on the floor cross legged and did the midday manasi. Then, offering the thal to Thakorji, he said with pleasure, "Every day I offer cold food (referring to the sweets alone at the time of puja), but today I got the chance to offer hot food."
Just as water rolls down when it finds a slope, Swamishri does not miss a single chance to offer devotion.
Today, giving blessings after his morning puja, Mahant Swami Maharaj said:

"Teamwork is seen all over the world. Teamwork brings great benefit. Once, in a football match, the ball came to a player. The goal was very near, but he passed it to another player. The other one scored the goal. If he had thought, 'I will take honour', perhaps the goal would not have been scored. 'There is no limit to what can be achieved, if no one cares who gets the credit.' Not 'I will make the team win.' That is wrong. The aim should be 'We want to win.' If one is selfish and tries to do it himself, things go wrong. Perhaps he may get the credit, but that is not right."
Swamishri, the very embodiment of wisdom, can give a deeply thoughtful talk on any subject.
While eating, Mahant Swami Maharaj saw school students in front of him and asked with curiosity, "Do they like laddus?"
Catching Swamishri's words at once, laddus were brought. Swamishri sanctified them as prasad. Each student was given one laddu.

For many this was a new experience, so they were eating in different ways. Swamishri laughed and said, "From tomorrow they will not come for darshan." Then he said, "Come tomorrow... we will not give laddus..."
How much Swamishri cares! How subtly he reads people's feelings!

Since Bal Din (Children's Day) was to be celebrated tomorrow, a question was asked of Mahant Swami Maharaj for their programme: "Please answer in one word: how can we increase our connection with the Satpurush?"
Swamishri wrote: "Nirdoshbuddhi." (Seeing no faults)
